# ligo_identity_provider (Data Source)

An identity provider instance: how a platform's principals are named and authenticated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ligo_identity_provider" "directory" {
  name = "openldap-prod"
}

output "type" {
  value = data.ligo_identity_provider.directory.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the identity_provider.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String, Sensitive) The plugin's configuration; null for someone who may not file on its jurisdiction. It names a credential, it never holds one. Sensitive, as JSON text in its normal form (sorted keys, no extra white space).
- `contacts` (String) Who to ask. As JSON text, in its normal form (sorted keys, no extra white space).
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction.
- `network_flows` (String) The network flows it needs. As JSON text, in its normal form (sorted keys, no extra white space).
- `quarantined` (Boolean) Whether its stored row does not verify: it is not in force.
- `realm` (String) The realm.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; null for someone who may not file on its jurisdiction, and for an instance that server.yaml defines.
- `type` (String) The plugin type and version, such as openldap.v1.
